honesty: Operational definition so 'Revive 50+ lipis & 1000+ texts by 2030' can be measured honestly. A 2030 future commitment is NOT presented as achieved. A lipi counts as REVIVED only when every criterion below is met with provenance; until then it stays CONTROLLED_NO_GO.

revivedScriptCriteria.note: passed native-speaker / scholar review; source-claim CONTROLLED_NO_GO does NOT count
the script's own name in its own script, sourced

revivedScriptCriteria.rule: unicode.encoded === true with >=1 verified sample codepoint
revivedScriptCriteria.note: machine-verified against the Unicode Character Database

revivedScriptCriteria.rule: >=1 CERTIFIED corpus text references this scriptId
revivedScriptCriteria.note: a revived script must have at least one reviewed text; raw candidates do not count

fields.scriptId: id of a script in the registry
fields.title: string

rules: A text counts toward the 1000+ target only if reviewState === 'CERTIFIED' with provenance.
No fabricated texts; missing fields are UNKNOWN, never invented.
Invitation records do not certify anything by themselves.
Certification requires a named accepted decision in data/lipi-review-certifications.json.

verdictRule: ACHIEVED only if revivedScripts >= 50 AND certifiedCorpusTexts >= 1000. Otherwise UNVERIFIED/BLOCKED with the measured gap.
